tagline: 理光便携相机，1993 年发布
description: 理光于1993年推出的便携相机。配备32mm f/4.9 - 64mm f/8.8, 2.0X Zoom, 6elements in 6groups。快门速度Programmed, 1 sec.(Super-night mode), 1/3 - 1/300 sec.(Normal mode)。感光度ISO 64 - 3200 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocus, 30 steps。

specs.闪光灯: G.N.19 m (ISO100), Auto / On / Off / Red-eye reduction
specs.英文简介: The Myport Zoom 320P is an autofocus point-n-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in July 1993 as the successor to their Myport Zoom mini.
